metadata.title: Stage 6 Selective Router Decoupled Ablation Matrix

r0_semantic_prior.name: R0: Semantic Class Prior Only
r0_semantic_prior.description: Static dictionary lookup mapping semantic class to movability prior

m0_semantic_prior.name: M0: Semantic Class Prior
m0_semantic_prior.description: Deterministic naive prior without vision or geometry

r1_geometry_motion_only.name: R1: Geometry & Motion SLAM Only
r1_geometry_motion_only.description: Inexpensive SLAM motion gates without VLM inference

router_disabled.name: Router (VLM Disabled)
router_disabled.description: Estimator-aware selective router with VLM dispatch disabled

r2_non_estimator_aware.name: R2: Non-Estimator-Aware Selective Router
r2_non_estimator_aware.description: Selective router escalating on affordance ambiguity regardless of estimator influence

r3_estimator_aware_selective.name: R3: Estimator-Aware Selective Router
r3_estimator_aware_selective.description: Selective router escalating only when estimator relevance > 0 and query utility > 0

router_selective_vlm.name: Router (VLM Enabled)
router_selective_vlm.description: Estimator-aware selective router with targeted VLM dispatch

r4_all_eligible_vlm.name: R4: All-Eligible VLM Reference Policy
r4_all_eligible_vlm.description: Direct zero-shot VLM affordance prompting on all image-eligible instances

m3_all_vlm.name: M3: All-VLM Multi-View Baseline
m3_all_vlm.description: Direct zero-shot VLM affordance prompting on all eligible instances

random_query_baseline.name: Random Query Baseline (1,000 Seeds)
random_query_baseline.description: Monte-Carlo query allocation baseline across 1,000 seeds at matched budget
random_query_baseline.interpretation: Within-benchmark query-selection variability across 1,000 Monte-Carlo seeds

oracle_baseline.name: Oracle Query Selection Baseline
oracle_baseline.description: Non-deployable theoretical upper bound using ground truth knowledge

counterexample_evaluation.note: Evaluator explicitly separates deterministic physical-support rules from genuine VLM inference. Text-only keyword matching is labeled as DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXTUAL_RULE_BASELINE.

case_evaluations.physical_context: Autonomous mobile robot docked and powered down at home station
